subject: microbiology
title: Hypersensitivity II: Delayed Type IV, Tuberculin Test and Shwartzman Reaction

steps.tx: **Delayed hypersensitivity** (type IV) is T cell mediated without antibody: sensitised Th1 cells meeting antigen release interferon gamma and TNF, recruiting macrophages over 48 to 72 hours into indurated inflammation (tuberculin), contact dermatitis (Th1 and cytotoxic variants), granulomas around indigestible organisms, and tissue injury in infections and autoimmunity.
steps.say: No antibody, two to three days, macrophages as infantry: type IV in one breath.

left.title: Type IV mechanics
points: Transferable by cells, not serum (Landsteiner Chase)

right.title: Type IV subtypes
points: IVc cytotoxic T (contact and drug eruptions)

steps.tx: The **tuberculin test** (Mantoux) injects purified protein derivative intradermally and reads induration (not erythema) at 48 to 72 hours against risk stratified cut offs (5, 10, 15 mm), reporting immunological memory of mycobacterial encounter shared by tuberculosis, BCG vaccination and environmental mycobacteria. It diagnoses infection exposure, never active disease alone.
steps.say: Measure the induration, stratify by risk, and never call it active tuberculosis alone.

left.title: Mantoux discipline
points: Cut offs 5, 10, 15 mm by risk group

right.title: Mantoux limits
points: Anergy false negatives (HIV, steroids, miliary TB)
IGRA successor uses specific antigens (ESAT 6, CFP 10)

steps.tx: The **tuberculin test**, called Mantoux, injects purified protein derivative into the dermis and reads induration, not redness, at 48 to 72 hours. Thresholds of 5, 10, and 15 millimetres are stratified by risk. A reaction means immunological memory of mycobacteria, shared by tuberculosis infection, BCG vaccination, and environmental species. Memory is not the same as active disease. Sputum, imaging, and the clinical picture still have to decide whether disease is present now.
steps.say: The Mantoux test injects purified protein derivative into the skin. Measure induration at 48 to 72 hours and ignore redness alone. Use 5, 10, or 15 millimetre cut offs according to risk. A positive result means mycobacterial memory from tuberculosis, BCG, or environmental species, not active disease by itself.

vis.alt: A forearm receives an intradermal injection, and a later view shows the firm swelling being measured across the forearm.
vis.caption: Purified protein derivative is injected into the skin, and the firm induration, not the red flare, is measured at 48 to 72 hours. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Contact dermatitis** is type IV at the skin: haptens (nickel, chromate, hair dye PPD, poison ivy urushiol) penetrate, conjugate proteins, and sensitise; elicitation over days produces spongiotic eczema at contact sites, diagnosed by distribution and patch testing (allergens under occlusion read at 48 and 96 hours), distinct from irritant dermatitis which needs no sensitisation.
steps.say: Haptens teach T cells once; patch tests replay the lesson under controlled occlusion.

steps.tx: **Granulomatous inflammation** is type IV organised for siege: activated macrophages become epithelioid and giant cells, lymphocytes cuff, fibroblasts wall, around organisms or particles macrophages cannot digest (M tuberculosis, fungi, schistosome eggs, beryllium, sarcoid unknowns), caseation marking tuberculosis necrosis within. Granuloma means containment succeeded and eradication failed.
steps.say: A granuloma is a walled stalemate: contained, not conquered.

left.title: Granuloma anatomy
points: Epithelioid macrophages and Langhans giant cells
Interferon gamma and TNF maintain structure (anti TNF breaks it)

right.title: Granuloma causes
points: Anti TNF therapy reactivates latent TB inside old granulomas

steps.tx: **Granulomatous inflammation** is type IV hypersensitivity organised as a siege. Macrophages that cannot digest their target become epithelioid cells and fuse into giant cells. Lymphocytes cuff the collection, and fibroblasts lay down a wall. The centre may hold organisms or particles such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis, fungi, schistosome eggs, or beryllium, and sarcoidosis produces granulomas whose target is still unknown. Caseation, the cheese like necrosis, points toward tuberculosis. A granuloma means containment has worked and eradication has not. The architecture is a stalemate frozen in tissue.
steps.say: Granulomas are organised type IV inflammation. Undigested targets turn macrophages into epithelioid and giant cells, lymphocytes surround them, and fibroblasts wall them off. Tuberculosis, fungi, schistosome eggs, beryllium, and sarcoidosis are familiar settings. Caseous necrosis suggests tuberculosis. The lesion contains the problem without clearing it.

vis.alt: A histology field shows an epithelioid granuloma with a Langhans giant cell, a lymphocyte cuff, and central caseous necrosis.
vis.caption: Epithelioid macrophages and a Langhans giant cell sit inside a lymphocyte cuff, with caseous necrosis marking a tuberculous pattern. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: The **Shwartzman reaction** is endotoxin's two hit haemorrhagic necrosis: a preparatory intradermal (or intravenous in generalised form) LPS dose, then a provoking intravenous dose a day later produces vasculitis, thrombosis and bilateral renal cortical necrosis in the generalised Sanarelli Shwartzman model, DIC's experimental ancestor, not a classical hypersensitivity despite its lesson filing.
steps.say: Two endotoxin hits, haemorrhagic necrosis: Shwartzman is DIC in experimental form.

steps.tx: **Drug hypersensitivity syndromes** distribute across types: immediate IgE urticaria and anaphylaxis (beta lactams), type II cytopenias, type III serum sickness like, and type IV's severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SJS and TEN cytotoxic, DRESS eosinophilic with viral reactivation, AGEP neutrophilic pustular), each with its latency signature (days to weeks) examiners use as the first sorting clue.
steps.say: Latency sorts drug reactions before any test: minutes IgE, weeks DRESS, days to weeks TEN.

left.title: Severe type IV drug reactions
points: SJS and TEN: keratinocyte death, mucosal erosions
Fixed drug eruption: same site recurs

steps.tx: **Tuberculin versus IGRA** comparison is current practice: interferon gamma release assays (QuantiFERON, T SPOT) use M tuberculosis specific antigens absent from BCG, single visit blood tests unaffected by vaccination, preferred where BCG muddies, similar limits in immunosuppression, neither separating latent from active disease. Programmes choose by logistics and prevalence.
steps.say: IGRA ignores BCG; neither test separates latent infection from active disease.

right.title: IGRA strengths and limits
points: ESAT 6 and CFP 10 specific to M tuberculosis complex
Cost and phlebotomy in young children debated

steps.tx: **Hypersensitivity pneumonitis and occupational lung** blend types III and IV (farmer's lung, pigeon fancier) with inhaled organic antigens driving acute episodes hours after exposure and chronic fibrosis with continued antigen, removal of exposure outranking every drug. It is the classification's reminder that real diseases mix mechanisms freely.
steps.say: Birds and mouldy hay by inhalation, hours to fibrosis: remove the antigen first.

left.title: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis
points: Acute: fever and breathlessness 4 to 8 hours post exposure

right.title: Management logic
points: Exposure history is the diagnostic instrument
Steroids for severe acute and progressive disease
Precipitins support exposure, not disease alone
